results.original: Inside the barrow, the dark is not empty: it is expectant. Somewhere below, the Great Underground Empire keeps a place for the one who gathered all its scattered brightness. Your adventure here is done, and well done.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
The cyclops, hearing the name of his father's deadly nemesis, flees the room by knocking down the wall on the east of the room.
results.retold: The cyclops, hearing the name of his father's deadly nemesis, flees the room by knocking down the wall on the east.

results.original: The thief is here, of course; this is his den, and he its jealous keeper. He rises from among the bags with his stiletto out, eyes already doing arithmetic on everything you carry.

The roar in here is a physical fact: water hammering through the dam somewhere in the rock, every wall repeating it at full volume. Your head refuses the assignment, and your legs carry you out before you are consulted.
results.retold: The roar is a physical fact: water hammering through the dam somewhere in the rock, every wall repeating it at full volume. Your head refuses the assignment, and your legs carry you out before you are consulted.

results.original: The room is deafeningly loud with an undetermined rushing sound, which the walls take up and hand back until it is difficult even to think.
results.retold: The room is loud with a rushing sound the walls take up and hand back until it is difficult to think.

results.original: The clasp is cunning past your skill. Perhaps a specialist — someone with delicate fingers and flexible ethics — could open it without ruin.
results.retold: The clasp is too cunning for your skill. Perhaps a specialist — someone with delicate fingers and flexible ethics — could open it without ruin.

results.original: You pick up the pile of leaves, which was heavier than it looked; beneath it, a grating is revealed.
results.retold: You lift the pile of leaves, which is heavier than it looks; beneath it, a grating is revealed.
